events.description:
Garden Grooves Sunday Special at Saltamontes with The Lojal Experience and Guests

Join us for a magical evening at Saltamontes as The Lojal Experience and special guests light up the night with their eclectic beats and soulful rhythms! Under the stars and surrounded by the lush Goan greens, grab your favorite drink and let the music set the perfect mood for an unforgettable night.

Come for the live music, stay for the electrifying atmosphere, and make it an evening filled with good vibes, great tunes, and memories that will last long after the night ends!

Hey! 🙋‍♀️

Today step into the electrifying JBS Vagator *Monday Open Mic*!🎤

Join us tonight at the courtyard for a creative explosion. Express yourself with songs, poetry, and improv acts on our open stage. 

Hosted by the fabulous *Sushant* joined by a crew of talented artists, musicians, actors, rappers, percussionists, and poets, this stage has seen 500+ mind-blowing performances! Grab the mic, enjoy drinks, and dive into the vibrant atmosphere. 🕺🏻💃🏻

Join us *6:00 PM onwards* for an evening of sensational acts, yummy drinks, scrumptious food, and enchanting tunes. 🎶🎵 Let's raise a toast to art and community! 🥂
